mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (group_id, sender_id, message_type, content, file_url, file_name, file_size, is_deleted, created_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT cm.message_id, cm.group_id, cm.sender_id, cm.message_type, cm.content, cm.file_url, cm.file_name, cm.file_size, cm.created_at, cm.is_recalled, u.username AS sender_username, u.avatar_url AS sender_avatar FROM chat_messages cm JOIN users u ON cm.sender_id = u.user_id WHERE cm.group_id = #{groupId} AND (cm.is_recalled = 1 OR cm.is_deleted = 0 OR cm.sender_id != #{userId}) ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT message_id, group_id, sender_id, message_type, content, file_url, file_name, file_size, is_deleted, created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE message_id = #{messageId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_messages SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
UPDATE chat_messages SET is_recalled = 1, is_deleted = 1, content = '' WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
